gates.description: At least one automated test file must be produced
No sleep() calls for synchronization in test files
No tests marked as .skip or xtest
Tests must be independent — no shared state patterns
Tests must cover both success and failure scenarios
No test stubs with TODO placeholder body

anti_patterns.description: Using sleep() to wait for async operations — causes flaky and slow tests
Ten tests verifying same behavior with slightly different inputs — use test.each
Testing against CSS classes or XPaths that change on every refactor
One E2E test with 50 assertions — when it fails you don't know what broke
Over-mocking all dependencies so the real system behavior is never tested

escalation_triggers: Test suite is too slow for CI (>15 minutes) and parallelization options are exhausted
A critical user flow has no automated tests and team won't allocate time
Test infrastructure is unreliable affecting team productivity
A production bug was missed because the test was mocking the exact failed component
Team is shipping without running tests because the suite is untrustworthy

input_requirements.description: Spec.md defines what behaviors to test

output_certifications: At least one automated test file produced per feature
No skipped or TODO tests in output
Tests cover both happy path and at least one error path
